integrity: The complete six-page foundational Lotka article was inspected at the exact equations, positive equilibrium, oscillatory solution, and positive-quadrant closed-orbit argument; document-wide searching found no covariance statement. A complete fifteen-page modern periodic-solution article was inspected at the exact equations, first integral, Poincare-Lindstedt construction, and results; full-document searches found no average, mean, or covariance formulation. A period-focused same-object article was compared at statement level and its mathematical classification was checked. The two conditional laws, mutual mean-independence, covariance cancellation, variance–per-capita-speed identities, equilibrium rigidity, and periodic crossing consequence were independently reconstructed and replayed algebraically with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes compact invariant support strictly inside the positive quadrant; extinction-boundary invariant measures are excluded.
It determines conditional means and covariance but not the full joint distribution, orbit period, or coordinate variances.
Zero covariance is not independence; nonconstant periodic-orbit measures remain nonlinearly dependent.
The classical equality of species time averages with the coexistence equilibrium is prior knowledge and is not claimed as original.
An equivalent weighted conditional identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Mutual mean-independence and exact zero covariance in the classical Lotka–Volterra flow
